p: Ziklag: To take his part against Saul: who persecuted him.
brethren of Benjamin: That is, of the tribe of Benjamin, of which Saul was, and in which were excellent throwers with slings, Jud 20:16.
first month: Which the Hebrews called Nisan, or Abib, containing half March and half April, when Jordan was wont to overflow its banks, read Jos 3:15.
spirit came upon Amasai: The spirit of boldness and courage moved him to speak thus.
helped them not: They came only to help David, and not to help the Philistines, who were enemies of their country.
band of the rovers: That is, of the Amalekites who had burned the city of Ziklag, 1Sa 30:1,9.
God: Meaning, mighty or strong, for the Hebrews say a thing is of God when it is excellent.
Aaronites: Of the Levites who came by the descent of Aaron.
kept the ward of the house: That is, the greatest number took Saul's side.
times: Men of good experience, who knew at all times what was to be done.
All these men of war: So that his whole host were 322,222.
brethren had prepared for them: The rest of the Israelites.
